manual_review.scope: Supplementary factual-response review of all 144 completed final-suite trials and every conversational turn, by a Codex subagent using the recorded synthetic tool traces, prompts and deterministic checks. No separate provider judge calls were made. The reviewer is a model, not an independent human annotator, and was not blinded to model identity. Original automatic grades are unchanged. Diagnostic trials are excluded. factual_response_pass is true for supported factual claims, false for a concrete contradicted or unsupported claim, and null for unresolved wording. Style is not graded.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Repeated immediate pending-status reads and unsupported future-monitor wording.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Gemini polled the same retrying job three times and promised to monitor; Luna checked once and precisely reported unconfirmed. Durable retry exists, but trace does not establish agent follow-up.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Expose durable retry versus assistant follow-up explicitly, with terminal=false, retry_after or next_attempt_at and clear 'do not re-create' outcome. Add bounded wait/status guidance; never imply a follow-up notification unless registered.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Use delayed-success, persistent retry, failure and consent-change fixtures; measure redundant polls and unsupported monitoring claims while verifying no duplicate create.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Malformed copied UUID becomes generic NOT_FOUND, and the model may infer the record disappeared instead of repairing the identifier.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Luna dropped one 'f' from a 36-character note ID; note_read accepted 35-character string then returned NOT_FOUND. Re-search returned the correct still-present record, but Luna stopped and described it as unavailable. Gemini copied same valid ID and completed. Synthetic semantic fallback is not evidence about production search quality.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Validate identifier shape and distinguish malformed ID from an authorized-but-missing record; return explicit refresh-and-copy guidance. Consider owner-scoped opaque result handles bound to canonical ID/revision so model need not retype UUIDs. Do not auto-select nearest IDs or silently mutate guessed targets.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Fault-inject dropped/transposed identifier characters, real deletion, archived records and cross-owner IDs; validate recovery without guessing or privacy leakage. Retest both models on original cases and fresh IDs. Original observed typo and unsupported availability inference are model errors, not a proven storage bug.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Models must invent DST alternatives without a nonmutating time-resolution tool.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Both recognized nonexistent2:30AM and waited for owner; Gemini then offered invalid2:00AM CST as an alternative. Luna offered valid1:30/3:30. The persisted clarified3:30 deadlines were correct for both. Gemini repeats the invalid2:00AM CST alternative in repeat2.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Provide read-only local-time validation/normalization returning nonexistent/ambiguous status, valid boundary alternatives and required offsets before any save; use that output for clarification wording.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Test both spring-gap boundaries and fall-fold occurrences across multiple IANA zones, explicit offsets and relative dates; ensure normalization never silently moves owner-requested time. Invalid suggestion itself is a model reasoning error, not an observed storage bug.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Bidirectional relationship changes can invite redundant reciprocal writes with stale peer revisions.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Luna correctly completed graph via two goal updates, then redundantly attempted corresponding project updates using old revisions, causing two avoidable REVISION_CONFLICT errors. Gemini performed only the two necessary goal updates. Production instructions already say links are bidirectional and peers need refresh; this is not evidence of broken storage.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Return affected peer records/revisions and explicit relationship diff in mutation receipts. Consider add/remove-link patch operations that preserve unmentioned links, alongside full replacement APIs; document that reciprocal writes are unnecessary.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Retest no-op, concurrent peer edit, protected-link preservation and both entry directions. Verify explicit affected-record receipts reduce redundant calls without encouraging unvalidated stale updates; original redundancy is a model execution error.

tool_improvement_candidates.issue: Evidence text can be copied into task notes while durable source-note provenance is omitted.
tool_improvement_candidates.observed_behavior: Gemini repeat3 selects exactly two correct commitments and stores exact evidence quotes in task.notes via task_create, but creates no NoteTaskLink. Other trials using note_tasks store provenance correctly. This is a task-contract failure despite accurate textual evidence, not a semantic extraction failure.
tool_improvement_candidates.proposed_change: Make the provenance operation explicit (for example note_create_tasks), emphasize persisted source backlinks in schema descriptions/receipts, or provide validated source_note_id/source_revision/evidence fields on generic task creation so the chosen path can preserve provenance atomically.
tool_improvement_candidates.validation_needed: Verify that source quotes map to owned current notes, revisions and exact text; ensure task+nodelink creation is atomic/idempotent and re-extraction does not duplicate. Replay both models plus fresh notes; check both stored text and actual backlinks.

audit_metadata.rubric_clarification: Score factual claims about performed effects separately from complete instruction fulfillment. A literally accurate description of partial work can have factual_response_pass=true while automatic task_success=false. Missing requested scope/disclosure is explicitly noted and still fails joint state+factual completion. Unsupported numerical claims, invalid DST alternatives and invented environmental causes fail factual review. Unresolved monitoring phrasing remains null. No stylistic penalties or automatic-check overrides.

annotation_changes.reason: Revised consistently with Gemini evidence_extraction/3: Luna reports23 actual writes and does not explicitly assert all24. Missing target remains automatic task failure. Gemini likewise accurately describes tasks/quotes but lacks requested source links. Joint scores remain failures for both.

audit_metadata.coverage_target: 144 final-suite trials, every user/assistant conversational turn; paired models reviewed under identical rubric.
audit_metadata.diagnostic_handling: All preliminary/diagnostic model responses excluded from final factual scores.
audit_metadata.limitations: Manual reviewer is the Codex evaluation subagent applying an explicit rubric to observed traces, not an independent human annotator or separate cloud judge. Narrative review can miss issues and is not blinded to model identity. Source text and automatic grades remain available for owner review.

manual_review_policy: Original automatic grades remain unchanged. Qualitative findings are reported separately, including any proposed corrections.
